theses.title: Passing on intent
theses.line: The bottleneck is no longer the agent but how clearly you can say what you want and why.

theses.title: Words that carry meaning
theses.line: Precise words and named ideas steer an agent further than paragraphs of rules.

theses.title: Rules vs judgment
theses.line: Fix the mechanical parts in code and rules; keep judgment for what is truly ambiguous.

theses.title: Make the right thing easy
theses.line: Shape the environment so the shortcut and the correct path are the same.

theses.title: Close the verification loop
theses.line: Stop being the first reader of every output; give the work a way to check itself.

theses.title: Context, not control
theses.line: Feed fresh context instead of approving every step, before the plan goes stale.

theses.title: Fix the kitchen, not the dish
theses.line: Sample instead of inspecting everything; batch problems and fix the system that made them.

theses.title: One-way and two-way doors
theses.line: Give freedom where mistakes can be undone; guard the moments that can't.

theses.title: Process you can pass on
theses.line: Your corrections are your process; capture them so you don't explain them twice.

theses.title: Questions that cut through
theses.line: Ask in a way that surfaces assumptions instead of collecting agreement.

theses.title: Climbing the trust ladder
theses.line: Trust is extended step by step, against a track record.

theses.title: Coordinating many efforts
theses.line: Work on the system, not in it; some roles coordinate instead of executing.

theses.title: Gardening
theses.line: Systems decay unless someone keeps tending them.
